description: 📋 React Hooks for form state management and validation (Web + React Native)

latest_release.name: Version 7.91.0
latest_release.body:
## 🐞 Fixes

- Fix `useFieldArray` not updating rows when using `setValue` or `setValues` (#13842, #13939)
- Fix `useFieldArray` not unregistering values correctly on unmount (#13843)
- Fix field registration without a value incorrectly adding array rows (#13846, #13849)
- Fix `useFieldArray` reindexing fields incorrectly when array rules are registered (#13873)
- Fix `useFieldArray` losing validation rules after `reset()` (#13940)
- Fix stale field array validation results after array changes (#13888)
- Fix `useFieldArray` validation after submission in `onBlur` mode (#13867)
- Fix dirty state updates when `setValues` changes field arrays (#13870)
- Fix stale asynchronous validation results after `reset()` and `unregister()` (#13908, #13912, #13934)
- Fix `Controller` validation using stale DOM values (#13880)
- Fix `isValid` not updating correctly after `reset()` and subsequent changes (#13847, #13930)
- Fix `handleSubmit` leaving `isSubmitting` active when validation throws (#13905)
- Fix empty validation message arrays being treated as errors (#13937)
- Fix delayed validation errors not being flushed on blur (#13861)
- Fix form state subscriptions and validity updates (#13866, #13877, #13906)
- Fix dirty state tracking and `resetField()` with falsy values (#13868, #13900)
- Fix `unregister` retaining validation rules when using `keepValue` (#13891)
- Fix `<Form />` handling of JSON, URL-encoded, multipart and plain-text submissions (#13848, #13854, #13874, #13893, #13907, #13915, #13926)
- Fix `useWatch` not updating default values when the watched name changes (#13859)
- Fix select options being lost before the form is ready (#13872)
- Fix `useForm` retaining removed options and disabled state (#13882, #13883, #13889, #13898)
- Fix progressive required attributes (#13924)
- Fix numeric zero `maxLength` validation (#13851)
- Fix object comparison for null-prototype objects and sparse arrays (#13853, #13855, #13857)
- Fix `cloneObject` handling objects with a `constructor` key (#13875)
- Fix `setValue` handling null-prototype objects (#13916)
- Fix form-level validation error types (#13860)
- Fix `useForm` mutating the externally provided `errors` object (#13896)
- Fix stale `NaN` and invalid date validation results (#13910)

## ⚡ Performance Improvements

- Avoid unnecessary copies when calling `getValues()` (#13894)
- Reduce unnecessary `<Form />` re-renders (#13899)

## 🧹 Refactors

- Simplify multipart Content-Type handling (#13926)
- Improve internal types and remove unnecessary type assertions (#13871, #13886)
- Clean up memoized component display names (#13897)
- Fix JSDoc examples (#13895)

## 🧪 Tests

- Add coverage for disabled field array operations (#13841)
- Expand regression coverage for `useFieldArray`, `reset`, validation and form state

## 📦 Dependencies

- Bump `joi` from 18.2.6 to 18.2.9 (#13836)
- Update `browserslist` and `baseline-browser-mapping` (#13837, #13838, #13839)
- Bump `follow-redirects` from 1.16.0 to 1.16.1 (#13913)
- Bump `vite` from 6.4.3 to 6.4.4 (#13914)

## ❤️ Thank You

Thanks to @vicuts, @maxymlyskov, @ahamsel, @dasjideepak, @feritcemkahraman, @DahanItamar, @arba-octo, @dfedoryshchev, @jeremiah-white, @TiagoGranelli, @zigzagdev, @nandyx, @hardikkaurani, @Marve10s, @candymask0712, @saaahilhussain, @itisrmk, @Enesuygurs and @bluebill1049 for their contributions! 🎉

Special thanks to the **Pennylane team** for their incredible support! ❤️
